$note: ADR-024's service status machine, as ONE artifact two Go modules can both read. services/api owns it in code (provisioning.transitions); services/cell-agent needs the same edges at runtime to avoid emitting a status the control plane will reject forever. The two modules have separate go.mod files and no go.work, so neither can import the other — before this file each held a hardcoded literal and only ONE direction of the drift was detectable: the cell-side copy could be widened with nothing failing anywhere, which is exactly the direction someone takes when a legal-edge test goes red. Both sides now assert against this.
